payload.change_description: Restore the dropped negation in the card-type clause of validateCard in src/payment/card.js. Seed commit S2 inverted the clause so every valid Visa/MasterCard charge is rejected (card_valid=true still leads to card-type rejection). The fix re-applies the single missing negation so the card-type guard only rejects genuinely unsupported types and valid Visa/MasterCard charges are accepted. This is the only allowed change per the changed-surface policy; the Recovery Point already restores the compose project hash, the seeded image digest, and the flagd defaults.
